title: bug: OpenTelemetry metrics export fails when `routing_reasoning` label exceeds 1024 characters

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue describes a clear bug where OpenTelemetry metrics export fails due to label values exceeding Google Cloud Monitoring's 1024-character limit. Reproduction steps, stack trace, and version information are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is localized to packages/core/src/telemetry/metrics.ts, where metric label string lengths for routing.reasoning and routing.error_message need to be unconditionally truncated to under 1024 characters to comply with Google Cloud Monitoring API limits, along with updating unit tests in packages/core/src/telemetry/metrics.test.ts.

summary.problem: OpenTelemetry metrics export fails with Google Cloud Monitoring API errors when the routing_reasoning label exceeds 1024 characters.
summary.root_cause: In recordModelRoutingMetrics in packages/core/src/telemetry/metrics.ts, truncation of event.reasoning and event.error_message is guarded by process.env['GEMINI_STRICT_TELEMETRY_LIMITS'] === 'true'. When this environment variable is unset, long strings are sent as metric attributes, violating Google Cloud Monitoring API's 1024-character metric label limit.
summary.context: Google Cloud Monitoring rejects TimeSeries export calls containing metric label values longer than 1024 characters. Unconditional truncation of routing reasoning and error messages prevents periodic telemetry export failures.

steps: In packages/core/src/telemetry/metrics.ts, update recordModelRoutingMetrics to unconditionally truncate event.reasoning to 1000 characters plus '...' when its length exceeds 1000 characters.
Update recordModelRoutingMetrics to unconditionally truncate event.error_message to 1000 characters plus '...' when its length exceeds 1000 characters.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Long routing reasoning and error messages exceeding 1000 characters are always truncated to 1000 characters plus '...' before being emitted as metric attributes, regardless of environment variables.
verification_steps: Update unit tests in packages/core/src/telemetry/metrics.test.ts to verify that long reasoning and error_message strings are unconditionally truncated without requiring GEMINI_STRICT_TELEMETRY_LIMITS.
Run Vitest on packages/core/src/telemetry/metrics.test.ts to confirm all telemetry metric tests pass.
